camera.near_width_status: working comparison value, final visual house-neighbourhood scale remains under review
camera.profile_interpolation: C1 smoothstep between knots in log(visible model width); constant outside knots
camera.target_height: actual current rendered terrain triangle including LOD and relief

input.damping: exact critically damped solution omega=18.9755/sec,95% at250ms
input.anchor: terrain-ray intersection, preserved each damping frame after pitch/relief/LOD updates
input.drag: same picked ground point follows viewport pointer; no release inertia
input.trackpad_pan: same ground-anchored viewport-pixel displacement, no special multiplier

bounds.ground_footprint: all viewport corner ray intersections with conservative rendered height interval [-1,9]*relief model units, relative to focus height
bounds.clamp: intersection of opened core target range and context inset by full footprint
bounds.insufficient_context: explicit telemetry failure; never claim filled background is geographic context

camera.viewport: stretch disabled; native viewport follows window; overview recomputed at resize, regional width and ground focus retained

terrain.height_sampling: bilinear pixel-center Float32LE canonical elevation, marine kind1 displayed at sea surface zero; signed land and inland height retained

constraints: same geographic data at every zoom
source DEM accuracy is separate from render mapping
